description:
As part of our software engineering team, you will contribute to the development of innovative software solutions that support the complete lifecycle of automated guided vehicles (AGVs) and autonomous mobile robots (AMRs). Our applications enable the production, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of automated forklift trucks by providing on-site diagnostic capabilities, centralized cloud-based data management, and seamless software and configuration deployment to vehicles in the field.

The team's mission is to simplify complex backend systems and technologies, delivering intuitive and reliable tools that empower technicians, commissioning engineers, and support teams worldwide. By ensuring a smooth user experience throughout the vehicle lifecycle, we help our customers and service professionals focus on their core activities while maximizing operational efficiency and system reliability. 
 We offer: 
 Join a fast-growing tech leader  shaping the future of intralogistics.
 Work in an international environment  with diverse, talented teams.
 Enjoy flexibility  with adaptable working hours and up to  40% remote work .
 Benefit from an attractive compensation package , including a company car, meal vouchers, and comprehensive insurance.
 Recharge with 36 vacation days  to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
 
 Tasks and Qualifications: 
 Work Distribution: The ratio is roughly 70% hands-on development and 30% design/architecture/support. We are also looking for someone who can bridge the gap to the overarching architecture team.
  
 45% Front-end development:  Angular.
 35% Back-end development:  .NET Core, SQL databases.
 10% Architecture & Design:  Aligning technical analyses and architectural choices, and enabling the team in this regard.
 10% Infrastructure & CI/CD:  Setting up, managing, and maintaining our Azure cloud infrastructure and pipelines
 
 Technical Requirements 
  
 Strong knowledge of .NET Core and Angular.
 Hands-on experience with Azure and Kubernetes.
 Experience in setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure.
 Experience with relational databases (SQL).
 
 Nice-to-haves (Domain knowledge / Advantages) 
  
 Knowledge of the embedded software world. Our software integrates with components on the robots themselves.
 Experience with or understanding of: Linux platforms, Yocto, C, Go. (The candidate does not need to program in these, but understanding this domain is a big advantage).
 
 Language Skills 
  
 English:  Must-have.
 Dutch:  Nice-to-have.
 German:  Nice-to-have
